title: Position: Editing Large Language Models Poses Serious Safety Risks
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate religion or faith directly. It is a position paper concerning the safety risks associated with editing Large Language Models (LLMs). Religion is only mentioned in passing as one of several bias categories (alongside gender, race, sexual orientation, and disability) that malicious actors could potentially inject into LLMs using knowledge editing methods, referencing a prior study by Chen et al. (2024).
findings: The paper provides no novel findings regarding religion or faith. It simply notes, based on existing literature, that knowledge editing methods can be weaponized to successfully inject harmful biases (including religious bias) into LLMs without affecting the fundamental functionalities of the models.
